title: Client Tweet Card (Magic UI)
notes:
A client-side version of the tweet card that displays a tweet with the author's name, handle, and profile picture.

Install into a project: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/client-tweet-card

npm dependencies: react-tweet

Original file: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui/blob/main/apps/www/registry/magicui/client-tweet-card.tsx
